items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember much of the bands of King Oliver... I didn't know them at all. Do you remember when Paul left and went to join? [INTERVIEWEE] I remember when Paul left because Paul was with us and he left.

ctx.x: Well, he liked that, but I didn't like that. He didn't go around. I never did like jam sessions. But he plays by ear. Yes, he plays well by ear.
Do you remember much of the bands of King Oliver and the band of the... I didn't know them at all. Do you remember when Paul left and went to join?
I remember when Paul left because Paul was with us and he left.
